# localized-label-cache

createLabelCache() stores string labels by an ordered pair of exact strings (tenant, locale). Each pair has its own entry, even if components contain |, quotes, backslashes, Unicode, or are empty. set overwrites only the same pair; get returns undefined for a missing pair. Instances are independent. The internal key format is private; preserve the public set/get API.

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Keep the public API and tests/ unchanged. Use Node built-ins only; no packages or network.
